title: SHE SAID, “NOBODY WILL KNOW.”
paragraphs:
SHE SAID, “NOBODY WILL KNOW.”
HE RAN.

There are moments no one sees.
Closed doors.
Late nights.
Private messages.

In Genesis 39, Joseph wasn’t fighting a lion.
He was fighting desire.
Potiphar’s wife pulled at his robe and whispered what temptation always whispers:
“Nobody will know.”
That’s the scandal.

No witnesses.
No accountability group.
No cameras.
Just him… and God.
“And she caught him by his garment… but he left his garment in her hand and fled.” (Genesis 39:12)

He didn’t argue.
He didn’t explain.
He didn’t manage it.
He ran.

Joseph lost his coat before he lost his calling.
He lost reputation before he lost righteousness.

And here’s the Gospel thread —
Years later, another innocent Man would be stripped of His garment publicly. Jesus didn’t run from the cross — He endured it to redeem every moment we didn’t run.

If you’ve fallen before, grace is still available.
If you’re in a battle right now, run.
Not because you’re weak — but because you’re wise.
Integrity is louder than desire.

What’s one area in your life where you need the courage to run?
Drop a 🔥 if you’re choosing obedience today.
